name: Aqua Simulacra
description:
When the character to which this is attached has at least 11 HP: DMG +2.
When played: The character to which this is attached gains 1 Max HP.
(Only Bow characters can equip this. A character can equip a maximum of 1 Weapon)

storytext:
"It is in defense of the purity of the source that water's gentleness can also become as blade and bow.
Conspiracy and coded language are interwoven with ease under the pale blue full moon — this is the wisdom of water's shape."
